mapper.select: SELECT compid id, location name, DECODE(adminid, null, '#org', adminid) pid, 'org' as type FROM comm_organization where ISDISABLED = '0'
select ROL_ID id, ROL_NAME name, DECODE(ROL_PARENT_ID, null, '#role', ROL_PARENT_ID) pid, 'role' as type from im_role where sys_type = 1

select cp.userid id, cp.operatorname name, urr.urr_roleid pid, 'user' as type from comm_operator cp join comm_employee ce on ce.badge = cp.userid join im_user_role_rel urr on cp.userid = urr.urr_userid where ce.isdisabled = 0
select u.badge id, u.empname name, u.compid pid, 'user' as type from comm_employee u where u.isdisabled=0 and u.compid is not null
select dept.depid as id, dept.location as name, decode(dept.adminid, null, dept.compid, dept.adminid) as pid, 'dept' as type from comm_department dept where dept.isdisabled = 0
select u.badge as id, u.empname as name, u.depid pid, 'user' as type from comm_employee u join comm_department dept on dept.depid = u.depid where u.ISDISABLED = '0' and dept.isdisabled = 0
